summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a board-authorized common stock distribution for holders of record September 30, 2026. Each class (A, D, I, P, T) receives a gross $0.0260 per share, reduced by class-specific stockholder servicing fees for Classes D ($0.0028) and T ($0.0097), producing net distributions of $0.0232 and $0.0163 respectively; Classes A, I and P receive the full gross amount. No transaction, stake, premium, advisor or closing timeline is stated, and the registrant remains the filer. The event is an ordinary dividend declaration, not a special situation.
